name: Susanne Blakeslee
biography: Susanne Blakeslee was born on January 27, 1956 in Los Angeles, California, USA as Susan Anne Blakeslee. She is known for her work on The Fairly OddParents (2001), BioShock (2007) and Spider-Man: Shattered Dimensions (2010).
